## 1. High-Efficiency Rectifier Replacement Review Tuples

[Cross-Reference: Rectifier-01]
- Candidate comparison (not approved compatibility): Vertiv / Emerson R48-2900U compared with Vertiv R48-3200e (also R48-3500e3). Replacement is unverified; obtain manufacturer approval for the exact part numbers, hardware revisions, shelf and controller firmware before selection.
- Electrical Spec: Input 85-300V AC -> Output -48V DC nominal (-42V ~ -58V DC), Rated 3200W (66.7A) / 3500W (70A). Efficiency upgraded from 92.0% standard to 96.5% Gold peak, reducing heat loss by 35%.
- Mechanical Fit: Unverified for the exact configuration. Confirm dimensions, guide rails, retention, connector keying, contact sequence, pinout and backplane ratings against manufacturer drawings; no drop-in or plug-and-play fit is promised.
- Bus & Protocol: Confirm manufacturer-supported protocol, controller and firmware compatibility for the exact configuration; automatic recognition, mixed operation and load sharing are not established here.
- Notice: Do not mix or substitute modules without a documented manufacturer compatibility assessment and an approved commissioning procedure.

[Cross-Reference: Rectifier-02]
- Candidate comparison (not approved compatibility): Huawei R4850N1 / R4850N2 (Standard Efficiency 92%~94%) compared with Huawei R4850G2 (High Efficiency 96%, BOM 02130833). Replacement is unverified; obtain manufacturer approval for the exact part numbers, hardware revisions, shelf and controller firmware before selection.
- Electrical Spec: Input 85-300V AC -> Output -48V DC (53.5V DC nominal, 50A continuous, 3000W full output above 176VAC). Efficiency jumps from 94% to 96.2% Gold rating.
- Mechanical Fit: Unverified for the exact configuration. Confirm dimensions, guide rails, retention, connector keying, contact sequence, pinout and backplane ratings against manufacturer drawings; no drop-in or plug-and-play fit is promised.
- Bus & Protocol: Confirm manufacturer-supported protocol, controller and firmware compatibility for the exact configuration; automatic recognition, mixed operation and load sharing are not established here.
- Notice: Fully backward-compatible; online hot-swapping requires no system reboot or busbar modification.

[Cross-Reference: Shelf-01]
- Candidate comparison (not approved compatibility): Huawei ETP48100-B1 (100A, 2x R4850G2) compared with Vertiv NetSure 211 (100A, 2x R48-2000e3) and Eltek Compact CT0S (100A, 2x FP2-2000). Replacement is unverified; obtain manufacturer approval for the exact part numbers, hardware revisions, shelf and controller firmware before selection.

- Mechanical Fit: Unverified for the exact configuration. Confirm dimensions, guide rails, retention, connector keying, contact sequence, pinout and backplane ratings against manufacturer drawings; no drop-in or plug-and-play fit is promised.

[Cross-Reference: Shelf-02]

Replacement is unverified; obtain manufacturer approval for the exact part numbers, hardware revisions, shelf and controller firmware before selection.
